title: PH60409: Statistical Studies Of Complex System
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definition of Complexity, statistical modeling of the fluctuations in the
physical properties, Introduction to maximum entropy approach, Introduction to
various techniques e.g. diagrammatic perturbation theory, nonlinear sigma model
and random matrix approach, semi-classical analysis etc.
